title: topoheat: Two-Way Coupled Thermoelastic Topology Optimization for Heat Dissipation
description: A reproducible engine for two-way coupled thermoelastic topology optimization, aimed at heat-dissipation geometry design. Every value is verified against a closed-form solution or an exact physical limit. A hardened JSON contract rejects physically invalid specifications before the solver; a bridge assembles the global mechanical and thermal arrays; a projected optimizer minimizes structural compliance under combined mechanical and design-dependent thermal loads. Sensitivities are verified against finite differences for the one-way, two-way, projected, three-dimensional, and thermal-stress objectives. The forward solver matches closed-form solutions at machine precision, the optimizer reproduces the canonical MBB beam, an algebraic-multigrid preconditioned solver holds the iteration count nearly flat as the mesh grows, and a monolithic Newton solve covers the strong-feedback regime. A single command, scripts/reproduce_all.py, runs the verification checks.
